findings.router: Optional construction-time Db-owned pre-parser bodyless rejection; receipt router after all stock hostname/cloud identity/warm-standby/actor gates. No plugin-config/request JSON hooks.
findings.nativeAuth: board_api_keys revokedAt/expiry + auth user lookup + current company membership; exact configured userId/keyId additionally required
findings.http: Default host remains 200 MiB/30-second socket budget. Trusted optional Inertia owning-host composition: 8 KiB request/header-parser budget, fixed 1 MiB raw response storage, compression/invalid UTF-8 rejection, absolute 15-second DNS-plus-socket deadline; original IP pinning/private denial/no-follow/TLS unchanged.
findings.sdk: worker-rpc-host serializes method/headers/body; does not forward AbortSignal
findings.secrets: ctx.secrets.resolve(secret_ref,{companyId}) at request time; never provisioned by this composition
findings.sourceAllocation: Full activity rows are materialized before validation; trusted binding strings/arrays lack per-row byte caps. Reason/page/response limits are not total source allocation limits.
findings.nativeJob: Schedule-free explicit manual declaration; real worker manager proactiveCompanyScopes from existing configured companies; state read/write capability required but not granted. Full-sweep reset prefers existing state.delete; get/set-only adapters use bounded JSON marker.
findings.rpc: Actual worker/host encoding is exercised. A raw-body cap has bounded JSON escaping overhead; no 1 MiB total RPC/process-memory claim.
